findings.finding: Resolution 2025-05-51 proposed Eagle Eye cloud cameras plus LPR analytics but was tabled by the Town Board on May 8, 2025.

By August 20, 2025 official minutes describe cameras at the new playground at Town Hall and a security-camera company reviewing footage, establishing an operating camera surface without resolving vendor or LPR analytics state.
